title: Modern Data Centers
summary: Join Xerox IT Solutions and Lenovo to learn how organizations are modernizing data centers to support AI, reduce costs, and improve resilience.
body_markdown:
Xerox® IT Solutions Webinar


# Modern Data Centers in an Unpredictable World


Hybrid Multicloud, AI & Infrastructure Strategies with Lenovo July 15, 2026 11:00 - 11:45 AM CST


Register Now


## Your Data Center Has More Decisions Than Ever.


From evolving virtualization platforms to AI initiatives and rising infrastructure costs, IT leaders are facing no shortage of data center challenges.


Join[Xerox IT Solutions](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/services/it-solutions) and Lenovo for a live discussion on how organizations are building more resilient, flexible, and future-ready data center environments.


### Modern Data Centers in an Unpredictable World: Hybrid Multicloud, AI & Infrastructure Strategies with Lenovo, July 15, 2026 at 11:00 AM CST


45-Minute Live Session + Q&A


#### In this session, we'll cover:


-


**Navigating today's infrastructure challenges** including supply chain concerns, availability, and Lenovo's Top Choice Express program Presented by Pawan Misra-NA Think Agile Product Manager


-


**Evaluating hypervisor options** in a changing virtualization landscape Presented by Pawan Misra-NA Think Agile Product Manager


-


**Preparing your infrastructure for enterprise AI initiatives** with Lenovo's AI portfolio and OneIQ capabilities Presented by Joe Murphy, LETS Lenovo Infrastructure Manager


-


**Managing costs and scalability** with flexible consumption-based solutions like Lenovo TruScale Presented by Tracie Heath Garcia, Senior Solutions & Services Executive


Hear practical insights from Lenovo and Xerox IT Solutions experts on how organizations are approaching modern data center strategy in an increasingly complex technology landscape.


We look forward to seeing you there!


Register Now
